
### Reece P. Kiesling

**Undergraduate Researcher | Briseño Lab**

Reece is an undergraduate researcher investigating the potential association between plant-parasitic nematodes and nepoviruses in wild and cultivated blueberries in Pennsylvania.

The project examines wild blueberry populations in forest ecosystems and cultivated blueberries in commercial production systems, focusing on the occurrence of nematodes and potential nepovirus infections. This research aims to improve our understanding of virus–vector associations and viral connectivity between natural and agricultural ecosystems.
